name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 77.5 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: Vajan 3 piletit homseks hommikuks.
entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.

entries.source: Meid on 5, sealhulgas 2 last.
entries.reference: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.

entries.source: Minu telefoninumber on 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: Lend kestab 9 tundi ja 25 minutit.
entries.reference: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Meid on 4 inimest ja meil on 6 kohvrit.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.

entries.source: Tuba 214 asub teisel korrusel.
entries.reference: Room 214 is on the second floor.

entries.source: Saabusin 3. oktoobril ja lahkun 9. oktoobril.
entries.reference: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.

entries.source: Mis kell avaneb muuseum pühapäeviti?
entries.reference: What time does the museum open on Sundays?

entries.source: Minu rong väljub kell 18:45 perroonilt 7.
entries.reference: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: Viimane buss väljub kell 23:30 täna õhtul.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Mul on broneering kell 20 õhtul 2 inimesele.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.

entries.source: Kas apteek avaneb enne kella 9 hommikul?
entries.reference: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: Üritus algab kell 14:15 ja kestab 3 tundi.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.

entries.source: Hommikusööki serveeritakse kella 6:30-st kuni 10:00-ni.
entries.reference: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Kui palju maksab kaheinimesetuba 3 ööks?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?

entries.source: See maksab 45 eurot, sealhulgas maksud.
entries.reference: This costs 45 euros, including tax.

entries.source: Kas on allahindlust 2 täiskasvanule ja 1 lapsele?
entries.reference: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?

entries.source: Pilet maksab 12,50 eurot inimese kohta.
entries.reference: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.

entries.source: Kas ma saan 78 eurot kaardiga maksta?
entries.reference: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?

entries.source: Kui palju maksab lennujaama buss 2 inimesele?
entries.reference: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: Päevamenüü maksab 15 eurot koos joogiga.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: Aadress on Calle Mayor 15, kolmas korrus.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: Minu hotell asub aadressil Gran Vía 28, metroo lähedal.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: Suursaatkond asub aadressil Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Palun kirjutage aadress üles: number 42, korter 5B.
entries.reference: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: Kohalejäämispunkt on Plaza del Sol, värav 3.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: Kas see on tee Carrer de Balmes 112 juurde?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Kus on lähim bussipeatus?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Pöörake fooride juures vasakule ja siis minge 200 meetrit otse.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.

entries.source: Kas jaamast saab hotelli jalutada?
entries.reference: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Milline liin sõidab lennujaama, liin 5 või liin 8?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?

entries.source: Vabandust, kas see on koht 14A?
entries.reference: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?

entries.source: Kuidas ma siit vanalinna saan?
entries.reference: How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: Muuseum on väljakust umbes 15 minutilise jalutuskäigu kaugusel.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.

entries.source: Palun kutsuge kiirabi, keegi on teadvuseta.
entries.reference: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.

entries.source: Ma kaotasin oma passi ja rahakoti.
entries.reference: I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Kus on lähim haigla või kliinik?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Olen maapähkli suhtes allergiline; kas see roog sisaldab neid?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Keegi varastas minu koti, milles oli 200 eurot.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Kutsuge politsei, palun. On juhtunud õnnetus.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
